mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO mission_log (session_id, node_id, mission_type, target_value, response_value, is_success, created_at) VALUES
(#{r.sessionId}, #{r.nodeId}, #{r.missionType}, #{r.targetValue}, #{r.responseValue}, #{r.isSuccess}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT log_id , session_id , node_id , mission_type , target_value , response_value , is_success , created_at FROM mission_log WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY log_id
SELECT n.stage_type FROM mission_log l JOIN story_node n ON n.node_id = l.node_id WHERE l.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY n.node_order DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT l.log_id , l.session_id , l.node_id , l.mission_type , l.target_value , l.response_value , l.is_success , l.created_at , n.stage_type , s.started_at FROM mission_log l JOIN story_session s ON s.session_id = l.session_id LEFT JOIN story_node n ON n.node_id = l.node_id WHERE s.child_id = #{childId} AND s.started_at >= #{from} ORDER BY s.started_at
